scope: Final claim-wording and literal-scope audit of 41 proposed new-PASS candidates, with MJ-REQ-254 excluded and retained PARTIAL. This is an audit record, not canonical acceptance.
conclusion: No additional literal implementation blocker identified in the 41 candidates after MJ-REQ-225/MJ-REQ-226 wording corrections. Acceptance remains conditional on root verifying relevant tests and exact-revision required hosted gates and artifacts.
method: Compared authoritative ISSUE_SEED literals with draft notes and existing per-criterion audit reports; reviewed relevant production/test boundaries and supplemented company-feed coverage. Does not claim a fresh full code audit or fresh test execution for all 41 objectives.

wording_corrections.correction: Describe all ten literal unsafe-input categories; credential handling is not a separately listed literal criterion. Security-test acceptance does not certify every broader security parent.

Describe production controlled form-fill tests with an in-memory Playwright double: special characters reach fill() unchanged, with fail-closed OS/process sentinels. Do not describe this regression as executed real Chromium.

MJ-REQ-223_supplement.purpose: Include generic first-party RSS/Atom/JSON employer-feed evidence alongside the registered Greenhouse/Lever company-ATS contract. These are existing implementation/tests, not a new implementation gap.

supplemental_evidence.evidence: Exercises the production RSS, Atom and JSON-feed parser; rejects unsafe or unsupported endpoint links, cross-origin links, malformed endpoints, entity expansion and non-job items; endpoint selection is deterministic.

Tests company/source identity rejection before writes, canonical endpoint matching, exact relative application-URL resolution, rejected endpoint changes, malformed-row enumeration/acceptance counts, rollback and later retry. Production _validate_source_identity binds company, provider, tenant, endpoint and collection strategy to the persisted source.

Traverses a controlled employer page, careers page and RSS feed through production discovery. Three enumerated rows yield two accepted jobs; repeating discovery still leaves two canonical jobs and two postings. Asserts stable python-role/support-role requisitions, exact employer application URL, source provider and deterministic matching. The javascript URL row is rejected. This is fixture evidence, not live company-career acceptance.

MJ-REQ-223_supplement.execution_caveat: Test node names and hashes are resolved against the reviewed revision; tests were not rerun for this audit. Root must attach actual successful relevant execution.

MJ-REQ-254.implemented_scope: Shared api/upload complete-response deadlines and five migrated direct-fetch paths; independent review found no blockers in that bounded patch.
MJ-REQ-254.remaining_gap: 21 active UI modules contain 32 unbounded injected-fetch dispatch sites; one further unbounded helper has no active UI importer. Navigation cancellation and finite polling counts do not provide elapsed request/body deadlines.
MJ-REQ-254.follow_up: Separate coherent change to preserve injected transports while migrating every relevant fetch/body reader to the existing complete-response primitive. No further implementation authorized in this audit.

pending_execution_and_scope_caveats.condition: Root must verify actual final-revision required Chromium, Compose recovery and hosted CI results/artifacts. Workflow configuration or test presence alone is insufficient.
PostgreSQL claims need executed PostgreSQL cases at the accepted revision; skipped cases do not supply evidence.
Keep explicit unknown timestamps where the adapter inventory supplies no date, including Lever. Do not imply an invented timestamp or date parsing verified from absent data.
Resource evidence uses synthetic reservations/claims and fake AI calls; do not imply hundreds of actual browser or provider executions.
Five-viewpoint Jobs/shell and keyboard evidence supports the stated bounded layout/accessibility claims, not every device/browser or a broad accessibility certification.

Optional local email classification does not claim Gmail/Outlook account integration or employer receipt; source/provider identity distinction does not claim every live integration; the literal graph requires data-model support, not graph editing.
Safe pre-call/staged-result recovery and explicit fresh intent are the retry evidence; do not imply automatic repetition of uncertain paid provider calls.
Practical bounded Python typing and adopted formatter coverage are accurately scoped; do not describe them as whole-repository strict typing or a completed frontend-wide reformat.

broader_parent_boundary: Passing a named test/contract requirement must not promote broader parents. MJ-REQ-224 public adapter journeys, MJ-REQ-228 live-source dedupe/persistence and MJ-REQ-229 live company-career discovery require their own evidence. Root separately handles live-source execution; company-career redirect blockage remains unresolved in the reviewed evidence.
